tasks.title: Manifest generator + CI integration in releases/
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-rpi-imager/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/imager.feature}. SECOND: implement releases/scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh that walks Packer outputs, computes sha256 + size per variant, assembles manifest JSON. Hook into releases CI on tag-build. Verify sha256 before upload.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd releases && shellcheck scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh && bash scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh --test-fixtures && jq -e '.subitems | length >= 5' tmp/manifest.json

tasks.title: Manifest signing + Pi Foundation submission tracking
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-rpi-imager/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: implement releases/scripts/sign-manifest.sh using the CubeOS release key from CI variables. (REQ-311) ECDSA sign + publish .sig alongside manifest. (REQ-307/308) Operational task: submit URL to Pi Foundation. Track in YouTrack CUBEOS-*.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd releases && bash scripts/sign-manifest.sh tmp/manifest.json && bash scripts/verify-signature.sh tmp/manifest.json tmp/manifest.json.sig
